lines.text: Many learners say: It costs two thousands yen.
Better: It costs two thousand yen.
After a number, thousand has no s.
Thousand! It costs two thousand yen.

data.why: After a number, thousand has no s.

native.tip: 数字のあとの thousand や hundred に s は付けません。
native.caption: “It costs two thousands yen.”と言っていませんか？😅 「何千もの」の thousands of と混ざって、数字のあとにも s を付けがちです。“It costs two thousand yen.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“thousand”。“It costs two thousand yen.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: After a number, thousand has no s.
en.caption: Do you say this? “It costs two thousands yen.” 😅 With a number, do not add s. The natural way is “It costs two thousand yen.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
